title: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID
question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

prediction.sql:
WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    co.order_id,
    co.customer_id,
    co.pizza_id,
    co.order_time,
    co.exclusions,
    co.extras,
    pn.pizza_name
  FROM pizza_customer_orders co
  JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(t.topping_id) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON b.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN (SELECT value AS topping_id FROM pizza_recipes, json_each(pizza_recipes.toppings) t) t ON 1=1
  WHERE 1=0
),
recipe_toppings2 AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON b.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN json_each(r.toppings) j ON 1=1
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN json_each(b.extras) j ON 1=1
  WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
),
exclusion_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN json_each(b.exclusions) j ON 1=1
  WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    'standard' AS source
  FROM recipe_toppings2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    'extra' AS source
  FROM extra_toppings
),
filtered_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    at.order_id,
    at.customer_id,
    at.pizza_name,
    at.order_time,
    at.topping_id,
    at.source
  FROM all_toppings at
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM exclusion_toppings et
    WHERE et.order_id = at.order_id
      AND et.topping_id = at.topping_id
  )
),
topping_counts AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_toppings
  GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_id
),
final_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    tc.order_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tc.pizza_name,
    tc.order_time,
    tc.topping_id,
    tc.cnt,
    pt.topping_name
  FROM topping_counts tc
  JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON tc.topping_id = pt.topping_id
),
ordered_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_name,
    cnt,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END AS display_name,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group,
    topping_name AS sort_name
  FROM final_toppings
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    GROUP_CONCAT(display_name, ', ') AS ingredients_str
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      pizza_name,
      order_time,
      display_name
    FROM ordered_toppings
    ORDER BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, sort_group, sort_name
  )
  GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id) AS row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients_str AS final_ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id ASC;

WITH
base AS (
  SELECT
    co.order_id,
    co.customer_id,
    co.pizza_id,
    co.order_time,
    co.exclusions,
    co.extras,
    pn.pizza_name
  FROM pizza_customer_orders co
  JOIN pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(t.topping_id) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON b.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN (SELECT value AS topping_id FROM pizza_recipes, json_each(pizza_recipes.toppings) t) t ON 1=1
  WHERE 1=0
),
recipe_toppings2 AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON b.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
  JOIN json_each(r.toppings) j ON 1=1
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN json_each(b.extras) j ON 1=1
  WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
),
exclusion_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.customer_id,
    b.pizza_name,
    b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(j.value) AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN json_each(b.exclusions) j ON 1=1
  WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    'standard' AS source
  FROM recipe_toppings2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    'extra' AS source
  FROM extra_toppings
),
filtered_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    at.order_id,
    at.customer_id,
    at.pizza_name,
    at.order_time,
    at.topping_id,
    at.source
  FROM all_toppings at
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM exclusion_toppings et
    WHERE et.order_id = at.order_id
      AND et.topping_id = at.topping_id
  )
),
topping_counts AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_toppings
  GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_id
),
final_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    tc.order_id,
    tc.customer_id,
    tc.pizza_name,
    tc.order_time,
    tc.topping_id,
    tc.cnt,
    pt.topping_name
  FROM topping_counts tc
  JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON tc.topping_id = pt.topping_id
),
ordered_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_name,
    cnt,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END AS display_name,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_group,
    topping_name AS sort_name
  FROM final_toppings
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    GROUP_CONCAT(display_name, ', ') AS ingredients_str
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      pizza_name,
      order_time,
      display_name
    FROM ordered_toppings
    ORDER BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, sort_group, sort_name
  )
  GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id) AS row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients_str AS final_ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id ASC;
